claims.claim_text: RP-3 regarding a male Hispanic walking westbound on Warner Avenue at Red Hill Avenue carrying a large knife in his bloody hands.
I immediately observed the subject walking southbound on the west sidewalk of Warner Avenue.
The subject was carrying a large knife with a white handle in his right hand.
Officer Torres parked directly in front of my vehicle.
I called out to the subject, saying 'Hey, man. Have a seat. Have a seat, Dude.'
Officer Vega parked in the southbound number one lane and drew his service handgun. He then holstered his handgun and deployed his Taser.
The subject stopped walking and appeared to look directly at Officer Torres.
The subject turned and sprinted directly toward me from a distance of approximately 32 feet, raising the knife above his head in an overhead stabbing motion.
I discharged my firearm five times at the subject. Officer Torres simultaneously discharged his firearm five times.
The entire sequence from the subject's charge to the final shot lasted approximately four seconds.
After the subject fell, I observed the knife was still in his right hand.
Officer Vega approached and secured the knife at approximately 0847:44 hours.
I initiated Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) at approximately 0848:39 hours.
A welfare check was subsequently conducted at the subject's last known residence. No injured parties were found at the location.
Officer Vega attempted to deploy his Taser but was unable to get a clear shot due to the subject's sudden movement.
